chunks: Recite what has been revealed to you of the Book of your Lord. There is no changer of His words, and you will not find a refuge other than Him.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that there is no changer of God's words in the Quran?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Kahf, this verse serves as a divine mandate for the Prophet to publicly proclaim the revelation, reinforcing the concept of *Tawqif* (divine preservation) against the distortions of the People of the Book. Shia scholarship highlights the 'no refuge other than Him' aspect as a theological anchor for *Tawhid al-Uloohiyyah*, urging believers to seek ultimate security solely in Allah amidst worldly trials.
